completion:
# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2. Collect as much information as possible about the defects at the site.
3. Use any relevant resources to help you with this task.
4. Take photographs of the defects
5. Annotate the photographs in as much detail as possoible
6. Also describe in detail
7. List the information about the defect on the maintenance record
6. Use any relevant resources to help you with this task.
# Bridge maintenance workers are always worried about falling from their positions above the bridge when the wind is blowing but they have no idea how fast the wind can blow at any given point. I need to be able to design a program which tells the workers at what wind speed they can work above the bridge without falling.
6. Use any relevant resources to help you with this task.
# Bridge maintenance workers are always worried
